summary: Adds the merge_group trigger to the CI workflow and keys the concurrency group on the PR number (falling back to run_id) so only pull request runs are cancelled.

change_description.evidence: Description lists both changes; internal CI change owes no changelog entry.

concurrency.evidence: Touches CI run cancellation (concurrency group), not code concurrency; github.run_id fallback correctly makes master and merge-queue runs unique.

correctness.evidence: Expression `github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id` is small; a glance confirms master pushes no longer cancel each other, matching the comment.

contradictions.evidence: New YAML comment 'cancel for PRs, not master or merge queue' agrees with the run_id fallback.

build_ci.evidence: Only file is .github/workflows/continuous-integration.yml: new merge_group trigger and a new concurrency group expression; CodeRabbit's head_ref-collision finding was already addressed before the initial snapshot, initial and final diffs are identical.

plan.why: A four-line CI config change with one axis to check.
